以下是针对微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部的完整分析。

---

## 1. 本季度收入同比增长了多少百分比？

**同比增长 32%（按报告口径），31%（按恒定汇率口径）。**

**计算过程与原始数据：**

| 项目 | FY26 Q4（本季度） | FY25 Q4（去年同期） | 出处 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Intelligent Cloud 收入 | $39,306 百万 | $29,878 百万 | `financial_statements.txt` 分部结果表（"Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 / 2025"） |

**计算：**
- 同比增速 = ($39,306 - $29,878) / $29,878 = $9,428 / $29,878 ≈ 31.6%，四舍五入为 **32%**（报告口径）。
- 恒定汇率口径为 **31%**，见 `press_release.txt`："Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)"。
- `metrics.txt` 中也确认了 "Azure and other cloud services revenue growth (y/y)*" 为 43%/43%（GAAP/恒定汇率），而整体 Intelligent Cloud 增长在 `press_release.txt` 和 `financial_statements.txt` 中一致为 32%/31%。

---

## 2. 管理层在财报电话会上把这个增长归因于哪些因素？

以下为 Amy Hood 在电话会上对 Intelligent Cloud 增长的原话引用（出处：`transcript.txt`，Amy Hood 段落）：

> **归因 1 — Azure 需求强劲：**
> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.**"

> **归因 2 — 效率提升与新产能更快交付：**
> "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations **driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity.**"

> **归因 3 — GitHub Copilot 消费增长：**
> "That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. **Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value.**"

> **归因 4 — 本地服务器业务合同确认：**
> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations **primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts.**"

---

## 3. 逐条标注：已发生的事实 vs. 未来前瞻性表述

| 归因 | 性质 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|
| **Azure 收入增长 43%** | ✅ **已发生的事实** | 使用过去式 "grew"，且有 `financial_statements.txt` 中具体数字 $39,306M vs $29,878M 的 corroboration。 |
| **客户需求持续超过可用产能** | ✅ **已发生的事实** | "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity" — 用现在进行时描述当前季度的客观状况，且与 Azure 43% 增长这一可验证数据一致。 |
| **CPU/GPU 集群效率提升** | ✅ **已发生的事实** | "efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet" — 用过去式 "driven by" 表述，指本季度已实现的技术改进。Satya Nadella 在开场白中也佐证："we increased the throughput for Copilot workloads 4X since the start of the year" 和 "we have reduced dock-to-live times for new GPUs in our largest regions by nearly 50%"。 |
| **流程改进使新产能更早交付** | ✅ **已发生的事实** | "process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity" — 同上，描述本季度已完成的流程优化及其结果。 |
| **GitHub Copilot 消费增长超预期** | ✅ **已发生的事实** | "Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption" — "benefited" 为过去式，指本季度已实现的消费增长。"stronger-than-expected" 是基于实际结果与前瞻指引的比较，仍属对已发生事实的定性。 |
| **6 月商业模式变更（按用量定价）** | ✅ **已发生的事实** | "following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value" — 明确指已完成的事件（6 月生效），且有具体时间锚点。 |
| **本地服务器续约带来更高的在期确认** | ✅ **已发生的事实** | "Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition" — "were" 为过去式，指本季度已发生的合同续约及其会计影响。 |
| **整体营收增长 32%** | ✅ **已发生的事实** | 有分部财务报表数据直接佐证。 |

**结论：本季度管理层给出的所有 Intelligent Cloud 增长归因，均为已发生的事实，没有任何一条属于前瞻性表述。** 这些归因全部使用过去式动词（grew, were, benefited, drove），描述的是已完成的 Q4 季度内的事件和结果，并且每一条都能与 `financial_statements.txt` 中的具体数字或 `press_release.txt` 中的业务亮点相互印证。

---

**所有关键出处汇总：**
- 分部财务数据：`financial_statements.txt` — Segment Results 工作表（"Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 / 2025"）
- 新闻稿业务亮点：`press_release.txt` — "Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32%"
- 电话会归因原话：`transcript.txt` — Amy Hood 段落（位置约 24808–25200 字符区间）
- 指标验证：`metrics.txt` — "Azure and other cloud services revenue growth (y/y)*" 为 43%
